visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A night street scene shows a building facade with several illuminated signs and an open shuttered storefront. A yellow SUV drives across the frame from left to right. A young woman wearing a white beanie and a white puffy vest stands on the sidewalk, looking up at a colorful banner hanging above a closed roll-up door. Lighting is dark with artificial highlights from the signs. (2) The scene shifts to a dimly lit, cluttered indoor space. The woman enters, using the flashlight on her smartphone to navigate. The room is filled with stacked boxes and appears to be a storage area or backroom. She exhibits a worried facial expression and moves cautiously through the narrow paths between objects. (3) She finds a man and a woman tied to chairs with black tape over their mouths. The woman in the beanie hurriedly pulls the tape off their faces. The man has bruises on his forehead and is wearing a dark suit. The setting is a dark room with a chalkboard covered in mathematical equations in the background. (4) A different woman with long brown hair and red contact lenses is seen sitting at a mahjong table. She holds up a small black remote control. Red mist or digital aura effects appear around her. She has a confident, slightly sinister smirk. The room has neon lighting and more chalkboards. (5) Four people are seated around a square mahjong table. The woman in the beanie joins the game. The table is covered in blue mahjong tiles. The players are shown in close-up shots of their faces and hands as they move tiles. The environment is hazy with a reddish glow. (6) The woman with the red eyes laughs triumphantly. Visual effects show red energy or smoke being drawn from the other three players towards her. Her eyes glow more intensely. (7) The video ends with a black screen featuring white text credits listing various names and social media handles, followed by a logo for 17LIVE.
